questions.stem: 24 g of magnesium reacts completely with 16 g of oxygen. According to the law of conservation of mass, what mass of magnesium oxide is produced?
questions.explanation: The law of conservation of mass states that the total mass of reactants equals the total mass of products. Therefore, mass of MgO = 24 g + 16 g = 40 g. No atoms are created or destroyed — they are simply rearranged.
